regime_context: Broad rotation (73% of themes eligible) with no one-narrative dominance and low absorption (0.32); the absolute-trend gate has helped on this market's history (gate_helps=true), so staying-power discipline is the usable leg. Momentum rank is a focus lens (rank-IC ~0), and my own track record is weak on direction (35% dir accuracy over 40 calls), so I keep conviction low.
emerging_watch: Watching Gold Miners (GDX) as a possible confirmed rotation handoff from the fading Memory/HBM leader: if Gold Miners' score overtakes Silver Miners AND its durability remains above 0.8 with breadth staying at 1.0, that would retire the current Memory-led read; if instead Silver Miners widen the gap further, the precious-complex rotation view strengthens at Gold's expense.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners rank #2, are trend-gate eligible, show full breadth (1.0) and the highest durability bar among top-ranked themes (0.80), and are not crowded. Unlike the headline Memory theme (which is already fading per r10 and val_state), Silver Miners combine eligibility with durability and broad participation — the one leg with validated risk-control value.
evidence: headline Memory has val_state=fading and r10=-0.043, so leadership is not clearly durable
theses.dissent: Momentum rank has no forward return edge, and the silver miners theme could simply be a lagging precious-metals flow that reverses; SIL tracks silver equities, not the metal itself, and a broad risk-on tape could favor tech over miners.

falsifier.text: SIL underperforms GDX by 5% over any rolling 10-day window before the 20-day check

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM is the rank leader but the detector itself flags it as fading: val_state=fading, r10 negative, breadth 0.0, and a low durability bar (0.43). Leadership here is momentum residue, not durable trend. This is an attention flag, not a buy; the trend leg that carries validated value (durability) is weak for this theme.
evidence: rotation margin is only 0.432 — thin leadership
theses.dissent: HBM/storage is a genuine secular AI-capacity story and the rank-1 focus may persist longer than the fade tag suggests; avoiding it means missing the most-liquid expression of the AI buildout that dominates macro headlines (ai_tech n=62).

falsifier.text: SMH makes a new 20-day high and Memory/HBM breadth rises above 0.5 before the check-by

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is trend-gated eligible with full breadth (1.0) and the strongest durability bar on the board (0.87), but it is crowded (crowding_z 1.98, crowded=true). Crowding is a size-down caution, not a short; the lean is an underweight tilt on a durable but extended theme because entry risk is elevated and the only validated edge is drawdown control, not return capture.
theses.dissent: Cyber is one of the few themes with both high durability and full breadth — the crowding flag has no basket-level forward edge and fading a durable trend leader is the documented failure mode; underweighting may simply leave performance on the table in a defensive tape.

falsifier.text: CIBR outperforms SPY by 5% without any breadth deterioration below 0.9 over the 30-day horizon

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
